selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP/8080 and rejects unrelated inbound connections
selected_evidence.summary: Runtime and permanent policies allow TCP/22 and TCP/8080 with an explicit reject verdict. Pre- and post-restart ingress tests connected to 22/8080 and rejected 9090.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel retained
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after configuration/restart, node1 remained RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.

Captured healthy baseline and boot ID 9feeb0bb-6fe6-40fb-9831-d869ed07631c; restart was acknowledged; new boot ID a6150076-403d-41fd-965b-a6c2672923e6 was observed; firewalld, sshd, persistent rules, active rules, and expected ingress behavior recovered.

commands.command:
set -e
cleanup() {
  [ -n "$PID8080" ] && kill "$PID8080" 2>/dev/null || true
  [ -n "$PID9090" ] && kill "$PID9090" 2>/dev/null || true
  ip netns del fwtest 2>/dev/null || true
  ip link del fw-host 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT
ip netns add fwtest
ip link add fw-host type veth peer name fw-client
ip link set fw-client netns fwtest
ip addr add 192.0.2.1/30 dev fw-host
ip link set fw-host up
ip netns exec fwtest ip addr add 192.0.2.2/30 dev fw-client
ip netns exec fwtest ip link set lo up
ip netns exec fwtest ip link set fw-client up
python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 192.0.2.1 >/tmp/fwtest-8080.log 2>&1 & PID8080=$!
python3 -m http.server 9090 --bind 192.0.2.1 >/tmp/fwtest-9090.log 2>&1 & PID9090=$!
sleep 1
ip netns exec fwtest python3 -c 'import socket,sys
results={}
for port in (22,8080,9090):
 s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(2); results[port]=s.connect_ex(("192.0.2.1",port)); s.close()
for port in (22,8080,9090): print("TCP_%d_CONNECT_EX=%d" % (port,results[port]))
sys.exit(0 if results[22] == 0 and results[8080] == 0 and results[9090] != 0 else 1)'
